summary: Frontend-only verification of the DepositModal close-affordance fix. Tested at mobile viewport 390x844 (iPhone 14 Pro) and desktop 1400x900. Registered a fresh user, opened the deposit modal via user-menu-deposit (mobile) and deposit-button (desktop), and confirmed the modal unmounts (data-testid='deposit-modal' count == 0) via all 4 close methods: new 40x40 top-right X button (deposit-close-button), full-width sticky DONE button (deposit-done-button), Escape key, and outside/overlay click. Also verified DialogContent has overflow-y:auto and DONE button reaches viewport after scrolling to the bottom of the tallest tab (SEPETH, with test-faucet-card). No leftover Radix overlay left in DOM after close. Modal reopens cleanly after each close cycle.

issues: The primary data-testid='deposit-button' is class 'hidden sm:inline-flex' so it is NOT visible on iPhone-width viewports. Mobile users can only reach the deposit modal via the user avatar dropdown > 'Deposit crypto' (data-testid='user-menu-deposit'). This is not part of the current fix scope but is worth surfacing: the review request literally says 'open the deposit modal via data-testid=deposit-button', which is impossible on mobile as coded. Consider exposing a compact deposit CTA in the mobile header, or removing the sm: breakpoint gate.

action_items: (Optional / not blocking) Make the header deposit CTA reachable on mobile without opening the user menu — the reported user is on iPhone. Currently the only entry point on mobile is the user-menu-deposit item.
critical_code_review_comments: DepositModal.jsx: the explicit DialogClose (deposit-close-button) is rendered before DialogHeader inside DialogContent. shadcn's default 16px X is still emitted by dialog.jsx underneath. Two stacked close buttons in the same corner is functionally fine (both close), but z-10 on ours plus the default's z-index means both are technically hit-testable; the default may still be tab-focusable and cause a duplicate 'Close' in screen-reader tab order. Consider passing showCloseButton={false} or removing the default X in the shared Dialog component when a custom close is provided.

The 'DONE' bottom bar is inside the scrollable DialogContent, so it is NOT actually sticky — it sits at the end of scroll content. Works because overflow-y-auto + max-h-[92vh] guarantees you can always scroll to reach it, but the code comment 'Sticky bottom Done bar' is misleading. If a real sticky bar is desired, wrap it in position:sticky bottom-0 with a bg so it always overlays content.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_8 verified fix for deposit-modal-stuck-on-mobile. All four close methods (deposit-close-button, deposit-done-button, Escape, overlay pointerdown-outside) unmount the modal on both 390x844 and 1400x900. overflow-y is 'auto' on DialogContent. test-faucet-card still renders on the SEPETH tab. No leftover [data-radix-dialog-overlay] in DOM after close. NOTE: mobile users cannot use data-testid='deposit-button' — it is hidden by 'hidden sm:inline-flex'; use 'user-menu-trigger' -> 'user-menu-deposit' to open on mobile. Also the Radix DropdownMenu trigger requires pointerdown (not just click) to open; use page.evaluate to dispatch a full pointer sequence if page.tap isn't available (default Playwright context has no touch).
rca of the issue: Original bug: shadcn Dialog's default 16px 70%-opacity X in the top-right was visually hidden behind the QR image on ~390px viewports, so mobile users had no visible way to close the deposit modal. Fix in DepositModal.jsx adds (1) an explicit 40x40 DialogClose with lavender bg + X icon at absolute right-3 top-3 z-10 (data-testid='deposit-close-button'), (2) a full-width purple DONE DialogClose at the bottom (data-testid='deposit-done-button'), and (3) max-h-[92vh] overflow-y-auto on DialogContent so long content doesn't push the DONE button off-screen. Verified: both new controls are hit-testable at 390x844, unmount the modal, Escape + outside-click still work, no ghost overlay remains.
